subject: Mutual action plan for Clearview pilot — goals & timeline
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Simmons <laura.simmons@clearviewhealth.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Intro + proposed MAP for Clearview pilot

Hi Laura —

Thanks again for the time last week. I wanted to put a short mutual action plan (MAP) draft in front of you so we can align on goals, owners, and a realistic close timeline before the kickoff. I attached a short PDF draft.

Proposed pilot objective (high level):
- Integrate Redwood Inference to power triage suggestions in Clearview's clinical search (read-only pilot)
- Target latency under 200ms P50 for typical queries; no PHI in model input for the pilot
- Evaluation metric: relevance lift vs baseline + user satisfaction survey after two weeks

High-level timeline (proposal):
- Week 0: Kickoff & environment access (engineer and security contacts)
- Week 1–2: Integration + smoke tests (engineering)
- Week 3: Internal eval & quality review (product + champion)
- Week 4: Pilot demo & decision checkpoint (procurement looped if moving forward)

Ask: Please confirm you are the internal champion for the pilot and the right list of stakeholders (engineering owner, security contact, and procurement contact). If that looks good I’ll have Soojin send a short MAP spreadsheet with owners and dates and Marissa will schedule the kickoff workshop.

Attachment: Clearview_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf (summary + checklist)

Cheers,
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Laura Simmons <laura.simmons@clearviewhealth.com>

Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + proposed MAP for Clearview pilot

Thanks Connor — this is helpful.

I can confirm I will be the program champion on our side. Quick intro to the internal stakeholders you should expect:
- Daniel Park (Engineering Manager) — dpark@clearviewhealth.com — will own the integration work
- Alex Chen (Data Engineering) — alex.chen@clearviewhealth.com — will provision test data and infra access
- IT security: I will reach out to our security lead and loop them in; can we use a short security questionnaire first?

The timeline looks reasonable; my only ask is that we add a short procurement gate after Week 3 so we can start budget approvals in parallel if the pilot looks good.

Suggested kickoff: Tue Dec 14 at 10:00 AM ET — does that work for your team? If yes, please send an invite and a short agenda (30–45m).

- Champion (Laura): Priority decisions and weekly syncs
- CS (Marissa): Kickoff facilitation, health checks, weekly status templates

Attachments: MAP_Roles_Timeline.xlsx, Clearview_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf
